column3: tool-web is limited to its brave_search credential: a manifest field `credentials` (exact refs or a trailing `*`) lists the refs a `secrets` row may get and set, the secrets facade refuses any other ref, and a row that declares none keeps every ref (mcp-server and deploy-hook, whose refs come from owner config)
column4: XIN-32 on #119: tool-web ships enabled with `secrets`, and the facade let it read and overwrite every stored credential; declaring the one fixed ref is a few lines in manifest, loader and facade, while config-derived refs for mcp-server and deploy-hook would be a larger change nobody needs yet
column5: src/kernel/secrets.test.ts: s-scoped reads SCOPED and is refused get and set on TOKEN; web.test.ts checks tool-web declares only brave_search; the Brave search test still reads its key
